'''Ryan Nicolls''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} and the [[I Choose You! trilogy|''I Choose You!'' trilogy]].

==Biography==
Nicolls was born sometime on March 6 in Sacramento, California. As an adult, he became a voice actor and became involved with a number of English-dubbed versions of international shows. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}. His most notable role so far in that work is [[Laki]]. Nicolls currently resides in New York City, New York, with his wife, [[Laurie Hymes]], who also voices characters in {{aniseries|PTS}}. Nicolls departed from the series in February 2021.
